FEAT-5-S137.title: Tool Invocation Contract Definition (Anthropic tool_use Handling)
FEAT-5-S137.description: Define and standardize the contract for parsing Anthropic tool_use blocks, including required fields (tool name, input payload) and normalization into the internal routing format consumed by tool_router.

FEAT-5-S138.title: Chat History Injection for Tool Context
FEAT-5-S138.description: Implement logic to inject prior chat history and system context into tool execution inputs where required, ensuring tools receive sufficient context without violating schema validation.

FEAT-5-S139.title: Unit Test Coverage for Allowlist and Validation Paths
FEAT-5-S139.description: Expand unit tests to cover allowlist enforcement, valid/invalid schema inputs, rejection of unauthorized tools, and correct dispatch behavior.

FEAT-5-S140.title: Integration Test with FastAPI Chat Endpoint
FEAT-5-S140.description: Validate end-to-end integration of tool routing within the FastAPI chat loop, ensuring tool calls from the LLM are correctly parsed, routed, executed, and returned in the response.

FEAT-5-S141.title: Structured Tool Response Formatting
FEAT-5-S141.description: Standardize the structure of tool execution outputs to ensure consistent formatting for the LLM response loop, including success, error, and partial-result cases.
